<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 20:6">Kel. XX, 6</cite> <he>ועשאו ו׳</he> (Ar. <cite ref="B00621"><he>בילן</he></cite>) and made of it a curtain (or sail); <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 11:8">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. XI, 8</cite>.
<cite ref="Beitzah 14b:16">Bets. 14ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>ו׳ טמא וכ׳</he> a door-curtain is subject to levitical uncleanness, because &c.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 52:5">Gen. R. s. 52</cite>, beg. [read:] <he>וּוִילון מונח ביניהם</he> with a curtain let down between them; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 52:5">ib.</cite> s. 74; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 1:13">Lev. R. s. 1</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 897:6">Yalk. Job 897</cite>.
Esth. R. to I, 6 נגללין כו׳ זה וכ׳ they were rolled up like the curtain before the ark of the Law; a. fr.—Esp. Vilon (Curtain), the lowest of the seven heavens.

<cite ref="Berakhot 58b:11">Ber. 58ᵇ</cite> <he>ו׳ הוא דמגלגל</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>דמקרע דמגלגל</he>, one of which is a gloss) the Curtain is rolled up (torn apart).—Pl. <cite ref="F00040"><he>וִילָאוֹת</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 4:6">B. Bath. IV, 6</cite> (<cite ref="Bava Batra 67b:7">67ᵇ</cite>) <he>את הו׳</he> Mish. a. Ms. M. (Bab. ed. <he>בלניות</he>, Y. ed. <he>בולניות</he>) the curtains belonging to the bath-house. Ib. 67ᵇ <he>בית הו׳</he> the room in which the curtains are kept. Tosef. ib. III, 1 [read:] <he>לא את הו׳ ולא את המרחצאות</he> (<he>הויסלאות ולא את</he>, Var. <he>הוילסאות</he>, being a copyist’s corrupt tautography).—Chald. pl.: <he>וֵילָתָא</he>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 105:39">Targ. Ps. CV, 39</cite> (not <he>וֵילְתָא</he>).—<cite ref="F00040"><he>וֵילָוָון</he></cite>.
